URL: https://www.consult-ds.com/
Title: ESG Readiness & Revenue Visibility Consulting | DS Consulting

DS Consulting helps leadership teams turn fragmented tools and regulatory requirements
into governed systems with measurable execution. Advisory plus implementation across
ESG reporting systems, marketing automation, CRM governance, and AI-enabled operating models.

Core message: Most leadership teams are making decisions on data they do not fully trust,
and are facing regulatory demands they are not ready for. We fix both.

## Services Overview

Two primary service lines:
1. ESG Advisory — governance, reporting systems, evidence trails for CSRD, BRSR, UK climate
2. Marketing Automation and RevOps — CRM governance, lifecycle, measurement, revenue visibility

Five capability pillars: ESG readiness, Revenue visibility, AI and data architecture,
Growth operating model, Location intelligence.

## ESG Advisory

URL: https://www.consult-ds.com/services/esg-advisory

Advisory plus implementation for ESG readiness. Coverage:
- CSRD and ESRS: scoping, double materiality, ESRS disclosure mapping, controls, evidence trails
- SEBI BRSR: KPI mapping, controls, value chain data collection, assurance readiness
- UK climate reporting: governance, risk management, metrics and targets, evidence standards
- GHG governance: Scope 1, 2, 3 methodology, emissions data controls, repeatable workflows
- Assurance readiness preparation (we do not provide statutory audit or assurance)

Key deliverables: readiness assessment, disclosure mapping, data ownership model,
evidence trail design, governance cadence, documentation standards.

### CSRD Advisory
URL: https://www.consult-ds.com/services/esg-advisory/csrd-advisory
Covers: CSRD scoping, double materiality assessment support, ESRS mapping,
data governance, controls, evidence trails, first-cycle reporting workflow.

### BRSR Advisory
URL: https://www.consult-ds.com/services/esg-advisory/brsr-advisory
Covers: SEBI BRSR applicability, KPI inventory, value chain data, controls,
evidence trails, governance cadence for India-listed companies.

### UK Climate Reporting
URL: https://www.consult-ds.com/services/esg-advisory/uk-climate-reporting
Covers: TCFD-aligned governance, risk and opportunity identification,
metrics and targets, GHG data, evidence trails, SECR compliance.

## About DS Consulting

URL: https://www.consult-ds.com/about

DS Consulting was built to close the gap between expensive, slow consulting and
boutique execution that lacks governance and architecture depth.

Our principle: Excellence in execution (Yogah karmasu kausalam).

### Why we exist
Big consulting can be expensive and slow. Boutique agencies can execute but often
lack governance and architecture depth. Tool sprawl across CRM, finance, service
and contact centre signals creates fragmented execution. AI increases expectations
and risk for quality, compliance, and differentiation.

### What makes us different
- Advisory plus implementation: we define the operating model AND implement it
- Governance depth: we connect data, processes, and measurement across systems
- AI with guardrails: speed and insight with governance for quality and compliance
- Practitioner backgrounds: Deloitte, Tata, Tesco, Godrej, Deloitte Digital
